entry-3.name: Entry 3
entry-3.description: North entrance. Every entry has an accessible path and free wheelchair escorts.

entry-4.name: Entry 4
entry-4.description: North entrance with an accessibility podium and waiting chairs inside.

entry-6.name: Entry 6
entry-6.description: West entrance for VIP and premium ticket holders.

entry-8.name: Entry 8
entry-8.description: South entrance with an accessibility podium and waiting chairs inside.

entry-10.name: Entry 10
entry-10.description: South entrance with an accessibility podium and waiting chairs inside.

entry-11.name: Entry 11
entry-11.description: East entrance for VIP and premium ticket holders.

guest-services-ne.name: Guest Services NE
guest-services-ne.description: Questions, lost items, assistive listening, free sensory kits and a sensory room.

guest-services-sw.name: Guest Services SW
guest-services-sw.description: Inside the Corona Beach Club. Lost items, assistive listening, free sensory kits and a sensory room.

first-aid-se.name: First Aid SE
first-aid-se.description: EMTs on site. Any usher or staff member can call them to you.

first-aid-nw.name: First Aid NW
first-aid-nw.description: EMTs on site. Any usher or staff member can call them to you.

pedestrian-ramp.name: Pedestrian Ramp
pedestrian-ramp.description: The stadium’s one pedestrian ramp. It reaches every level except Level 7.
pedestrian-ramp.location: Southeast side, behind the end zone

lactation-suite.name: Lactation Suite
lactation-suite.description: Private Mamava lactation pod. Family restrooms are on every level.

rideshare-kareem.name: Rideshare Drop-off
rideshare-kareem.description: Uber, Lyft and taxi drop-off. Pick-up is at Kareem Court and Manchester Boulevard.
rideshare-kareem.location: Kareem Court, between Pincay Drive and Manchester Boulevard

accessible-drop-off.name: Accessible Drop-off
accessible-drop-off.description: Drop-off and pick-up for guests with disabilities. Come in from northbound Prairie Avenue via Arbor Vitae Street.
accessible-drop-off.location: District Drive, between Champions Way and Touchdown Drive

brown-zone.name: Brown Zone
brown-zone.description: Parking closest to Entries 1–5 and 12. ADA stalls in every lot, first come, first served.

blue-zone.name: Blue Zone
blue-zone.description: Parking closest to Entries 7 and 8. ADA stalls in every lot, first come, first served.

orange-zone.name: Orange Zone
orange-zone.description: Parking closest to Entries 10, 11 and 12. ADA stalls in every lot, first come, first served.

kobe-bryant-entrance.name: Kobe Bryant Entrance
kobe-bryant-entrance.description: Main entrance for all tickets. GA floor tickets enter here.
kobe-bryant-entrance.location: Chick Hearn Ct. (11th St.) at Georgia St.

star-plaza-entrance.name: Star Plaza Entrance
star-plaza-entrance.description: Main entrance for all tickets, between the Box Office and Team LA Store.
star-plaza-entrance.location: Chick Hearn Ct. (11th St.) at Figueroa St.

figueroa-entrance.name: Figueroa Entrance
figueroa-entrance.description: Main entrance for all tickets. Ask here for a free wheelchair escort.

guest-services-m12.name: Guest Services M12
guest-services-m12.description: Questions, lost items, assistive listening, sensory bags and weighted lap pads (ID needed).
guest-services-m12.location: Main Concourse, across from aisle M12

guest-services-u6.name: Guest Services U6
guest-services-u6.description: Questions, lost items, sensory bags and lap pads. Ask here for the Sensory Pod code.
guest-services-u6.location: Upper Concourse, across from aisle U6

first-aid-m3.name: First Aid M3
first-aid-m3.description: EMTs at every event, with a quiet area inside.
first-aid-m3.location: Main Concourse, across from aisle M3

first-aid-u22.name: First Aid U22
first-aid-u22.description: EMTs at every event, with a quiet area inside.
first-aid-u22.location: Upper Concourse, across from aisle U22

sensory-pod.name: Sensory Pod
sensory-pod.description: Quiet pod for one or two guests, open during every event. Guest Services has the door code.

restroom-m23.name: Restroom M23
restroom-m23.description: All-gender restroom with a changing table. Every restroom is wheelchair accessible.
restroom-m23.location: Main Concourse, across from aisle M23

restroom-u31.name: Restroom U31
restroom-u31.description: All-gender restroom with a changing table. Every restroom is wheelchair accessible.
restroom-u31.location: Upper Concourse, across from aisle U31

rideshare-chick-hearn.name: Chick Hearn Rideshare
rideshare-chick-hearn.description: Rideshare drop-off and pick-up in the white zone (eastbound).
rideshare-chick-hearn.location: Chick Hearn Ct., between L.A. Live Way and Georgia St.

rideshare-figueroa.name: Figueroa Rideshare
rideshare-figueroa.description: Rideshare drop-off and pick-up in the white zone (southbound).
rideshare-figueroa.location: Figueroa St., between 12th St. and Pico Blvd.

west-garage-lot-w.name: West Garage (Lot W)
west-garage-lot-w.description: Arena garage, entered from Chick Hearn Ct. or Georgia St.

main-entrance.name: Main Entrance
main-entrance.description: GameFace ID lane on the left, Identity Pass lane on the right. Free mobility help from security to your seat.
main-entrance.location: On the plaza, off Century Blvd. and Prairie Ave.

vip-entrance.name: VIP Entrance
vip-entrance.description: For suite, club and floor ticket holders.

wall-entrance.name: The Wall Entrance
wall-entrance.location: Left of the Main Entrance, past the VIP Entrance

answers-portal-main.name: Answers Portal Main
answers-portal-main.description: Guest services: lost and found, free assisted listening (photo ID held) and OneCourt devices.

answers-portal-terrace.name: Answers Portal Terrace
answers-portal-terrace.description: Guest services: lost and found and free assisted listening (photo ID held).

first-aid-floor.name: First Aid Floor
first-aid-floor.location: Floor Level, under Wall 19 by the east tunnel

sensory-room.name: Sensory Room
sensory-room.description: The private Kaiser Permanente Sensory Room. Sensory bags are available on request.
sensory-room.location: Ask an Arena Host for the way

infant-care-room.name: Infant Care Room
infant-care-room.description: A private room for infant care. Universal restrooms are all around the arena.

mobility-hub.name: Mobility Hub
mobility-hub.description: Rideshare and taxi drop-off and pick-up, family drop-off and shuttles.

east-garage.name: East Garage
east-garage.description: Standard parking; buy a pass ahead. Accessible spaces are sold first come, first served.

west-garage.name: West Garage
west-garage.description: VIP parking across Prairie Ave.; buy a pass ahead.
